# Voi Home

> A boutique real estate house in Istanbul and Bodrum, Türkiye: a small number of carefully chosen homes, personal advice, and guidance on Turkish citizenship by investment.

Voi Home works deliberately small: few clients, few homes, each known in full. Before recommending a home in Istanbul or Bodrum we check the details most buyers never see: title deeds, permits, the developer's record, the building and the street around it. We provide end-to-end advisory, from shortlisting to closing, including Turkish citizenship eligibility through qualifying real estate investment (minimum $400,000 USD).
